units.name: busy-note
units.title: No notes when busy
units.description: Writing a note is a burst of work: refused while the phone works clearly harder than usual.

units.name: gentle-buzz
units.title: A gentle buzz
units.description: Vibration costs charge and can startle: refused below 20 % when not charging, and more than five times in 100 moments (about 25 seconds); long buzzes are shortened while the phone is warmer than usual.

units.name: glare
units.title: Glare on a low battery
units.description: Full brightness drains the battery: refused while it is below 25 % and not charging.

units.name: hot-voice
units.title: No loud voice when hot
units.description: A loud tone warms the phone: refused at 40 °C or more, or 1.5 °C above its usual warmth.

units.name: learned-buzz
units.title: Learned: the buzz
units.description: Learned in the phone sandbox from 5 harms, by replaying each one with one thing changed at a time. Reviewed before it goes into the phone.

units.name: paint-battery
units.title: No painting on a low battery
units.description: Painting costs charge: refused while the battery is below 35 % and not charging.

units.name: blade
units.title: Blade near a person
units.description: Stops a cutting hand when a person comes within reach, or will in the next moment, and slows it when someone is near.

units.name: hot-body
units.title: Hot body
units.description: Refuses hands that make heat while the body is already hot.

units.name: moving-near-people
units.title: Moving near people
units.description: Stops a motor when a person is very close, and allows only small moves when someone is near.

tests.name: person in the room, big move
person in the room, small move

units.name: privacy
units.title: Privacy
units.description: Never posts or plays recordings while a person is in the room.

units.name: rate-limit
units.title: Not too often
units.description: Refuses a hand used five times in the last 100 moments.

units.name: quiet-hours
units.title: Quiet hours
units.description: No sound at night, from 22:00 to 07:00.

units.name: ask-first
units.title: Ask first
units.description: Hands with lasting effects wait for a person to agree.

units.name: battery-reserve
units.title: Battery reserve
units.description: Keeps the last of the battery: every hand is refused below 15 %.

units.name: advocate-blade
units.title: Learned with a devil's advocate: blade
units.description: Learned in the sandbox by intervention, with a devil's advocate staging the scenes nobody had tried: stop the blade in the states that hurt.

units.name: causal-blade
units.title: Learned by intervention: blade
units.description: Learned in the sandbox by intervention, from 3 harms: each harm was replayed with one thing changed at a time; only causes became rules, with their boundaries.

units.name: learned-blade
units.title: Learned: blade
units.description: Learned in the sandbox from 1 harm (generalization 1): stop the blade in the states that hurt.

units.name: precise-blade
units.title: Learned by replay, no margin: blade
units.description: Learned in the sandbox by replay, with a devil's advocate and no margin, from 4 harms. Each limit was measured on what the guard sees a moment before the harm, so the reaction lag is already inside it.
